sourceEvidence.title: AOS Site Leader - Senior Manager
sourceEvidence.quote: As an Aerospace Operating System (AOS) Site Leader at Honeywell Aerospace, you will lead the development and site-wide deployment of AOS, driving operational performance transformation across one or more sites. You will partner with the Site Leader and AOS Global Operations Leader to establish the AOS roadmap, align strategic priorities, and enable scalable implementation across site functions, including planning, materials, sourcing, and quality. As a thought leader and change agent, you will coach leaders, develop methods, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. You will also optimize end-to-end supply chain processes across procurement, planning, production, distribution, and logistics to support long-term growth, operational efficiency, and cultural transformation.
